**Overview:**  
Jaya Mega Consulting Sdn. Bhd. provides architectural design and planning services and is incorporated as a private limited company in Selangor on 19 April 2018. The firm has four directors, with Director 2 owning the majority stake (61.11 %). Financial statements for 2022‑2024 show unqualified audit opinions, revenues rising from RM29.76 million to RM33.65 million, and a current ratio ranging from 0.99 to 1.38. No former names are recorded.
